subject: science
passage: Mimosa pudica, a small plant native to Central and South America, is often called the sensitive plant. When an insect lands on it or a person brushes against it, its feathery leaves fold up within seconds. <u>The leaves move this way because water rapidly flows out of special cells at their bases, causing those cells to go limp.</u> After several minutes, the cells fill with water again and the leaves reopen.
stem: Which choice best describes the function of the underlined sentence in the text as a whole?

choices.A: It describes the insects that most often land on the plant.
choices.B: It explains why the leaves move as the previous sentence describes.
choices.C: It suggests that the leaves stay folded once they have closed.
choices.D: It introduces a second kind of plant whose leaves fold up in the same way.

explanation.why: The sentence before the underlined one describes what happens: the leaves "fold up within seconds" when touched. The underlined sentence begins "The leaves move this way because," so it gives the reason for that movement: water leaving cells at the leaf bases.
explanation.A: Incorrect. Insects are mentioned only as one thing that can touch the plant; no insects are described.
explanation.B: Correct. The sentence explains why the leaves fold: water flows out of cells at their bases and the cells go limp.
explanation.C: Incorrect. The last sentence says the leaves "reopen" after several minutes, so they do not stay folded.
explanation.D: Incorrect. The sentence is still about Mimosa pudica; no second plant is introduced.
